what: On first open, dozens of collage pieces (photos, stickers, patterns) pop out around the logo on a gray scrim and cover the screen. A few pre-picked pieces switch on first from .1s at 55ms intervals over .28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1). From .65s the rest switch on in random order every 7ms over .1s ease-out. At 1.45s the scrim lifts over .7s and fx:open fires, then fx:done once it has fully lifted. A 7-day cookie means the scrim is not shown from the second visit on.

options.[data-fx-part=piece]: Pieces (required, multiple) — anything: SVG rect, g or HTML elements
options.first: Order of pieces to light first (comma separated), default 2,4,10,17,23,24
options.rest-at · rest-step · rest-dur: When the rest starts (ms) · interval (ms) · length (s), default 650 · 7 · .1
options.close: When the curtain starts lifting (ms), default 1450
options.once: If none, plays every time it opens (default cookie — 7 days)
options.narrow: Below this width (px) the curtain is not shown, default 767

use:
…
— Turn on hero copy 350ms after fx:open and the other sections at 750ms (original)
note: The original fetches opening.svg, which holds thirty-five pieces, and turns on the rects one by one (life-design scripts.js). On screens that get flipped often, shorten close.

from.where: index.html #opening (gray curtain · 34 pieces · lifts after 1.45s → .mv-copy 350ms · other sections 750ms)
